query: UPDATE discovery_jobs j SET withdrawn=true,search_run_id=NULL,lease_token=NULL,lease_owner=NULL,leased_until=NULL,cursor=NULL,last_error=$3 FROM discovery_video_work w WHERE w.job_id=j.id AND j.operation='refresh_entry' AND (w.owner_uri=$1 OR ($2::text IS NULL AND w.channel_uri=$1)) AND ($2::text IS NULL OR j.target_uri=$2)
